headline: Stocks Fall and Oil Jumps as Big Tech Earnings Disappoint
summary: Earnings reports from major technology companies spooked investors, triggering a sell-off in equities while oil prices rose to their highest levels in months amid mounting risks.
why: Corporate earnings from mega-cap tech firms strongly influence broader market benchmarks and sentiment. Rising crude oil prices can escalate inflation pressures, complicating monetary policy for central banks.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Disappointing earnings results from big tech firms triggered direct selling pressure in the sector.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Mounting geopolitical and supply risks drove crude oil prices to multi-month highs.

why_moved: Equities declined as quarterly earnings from major technology companies failed to meet investor expectations, while oil prices surged to multi-month highs on heightened geopolitical risks.
